name: Skilled Worker visa

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a confirmed job offer from a UK employer holding a valid sponsor licence, which you don't currently have.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from an employer on the UK register of licensed sponsors.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a salary of at least £41,700/year (or the occupation-specific going rate, whichever is higher), which your current offer doesn't meet.
requirements.fix_path: Negotiate a higher salary, or apply via the new entrant / Immigration Salary List / PhD discount routes if eligible.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires English proficiency at CEFR level B2 (reading, writing, speaking, and listening), which you haven't yet evidenced.
requirements.fix_path: Pass an approved English language test at B2 or above.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a role at RQF level 6 or above (broadly degree-level) that appears on the eligible occupations list.
requirements.fix_path: Confirm your SOC code and skill level against the published eligible occupations list.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a confirmed job offer from a UK employer holding a valid sponsor licence, which you don't currently have.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from an employer on the UK register of licensed sponsors.

requirements.blocker_text: This discount requires being under 26, a recent graduate within the last 2 years, or switching from a Student/Graduate visa.
This requires a salary of at least £33,400/year under the new entrant discount, which your current offer doesn't meet.
requirements.fix_path: Negotiate a higher salary or reconsider the standard route.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires English proficiency at CEFR level B2, which you haven't yet evidenced.
requirements.fix_path: Pass an approved English language test at B2 or above.

evidence_required.document: Approved English test certificate (or degree taught in English)
Bank statement showing at least £1,270 held for 28 days
Tuberculosis test certificate (if from a listed country)

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: no more than 180 days absent in any rolling 12-month period during the qualifying period

sources.title: Skilled Worker visa: Knowledge of English - GOV.UK

notes: General threshold rose to £41,700 on 22 July 2025. Multiple 2026-dated third-party guides (including some marked 'updated' in 2026) still publish the superseded £38,700 figure — this is the flagship example for the counterfeit-test feature. English requirement rose from B1 to B2 for new applicants from 8 January 2026. This file covers the standard and new-entrant groups only; ISL and PhD discount groups are not yet encoded. switchable_to left empty until uk_ilr_skilled_worker is encoded as its own route file — the validator rejects references to routes that don't exist yet.
